now.title: Daredevil S1
now.text: In episode 5, Nurse Claire finds a wounded Matt in a dumpster and becomes his medic and confidante.

proposed.text: In episode 2, Nurse Claire finds a wounded Matt in a dumpster and becomes his medic and confidante.

changes.evidence: Daredevil season 1 episode 2 'Cut Man': a severely injured Murdock is found in a dumpster by nurse Claire Temple, who takes him to her apartment and tends his wounds. Episode 5 is 'World on Fire'.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 44, Terrigen Mist gives her earthquake powers, and she learns her birth name is Daisy Johnson.

proposed.text: In episode 32, Terrigen Mist gives her earthquake powers, and she learns her birth name is Daisy Johnson.

changes.evidence: Both events are in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episode 32 (S2E10 'What They Become') in San Juan: Cal tells Skye her name is Daisy, and Skye is cocooned by the Diviner's Terrigen crystal (the same event that kills Trip, recorded in this chunk as episode 32). Episode 44 (S.O.S. Part Two) is the Iliad battle with Jiaying.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 133, in a changed past, Nathaniel Malick seizes Afterlife and kills both Jiaying and Gordon, taking Gordon's powers.

proposed.text: In episode 133, in a changed past, Nathaniel Malick seizes Afterlife and gives Gordon's powers to John Garrett, killing Gordon. He then kills Jiaying at the Lighthouse.

changes.evidence: AoS S7E10 'Stolen' (episode 133): Nathaniel captures Coulson and Gordon at Afterlife and transfers Gordon's powers to Garrett, killing Gordon; Garrett then teleports Nathaniel to the Lighthouse, where S.H.I.E.L.D. was protecting Jiaying, and Nathaniel kills her there. Nathaniel does not take Gordon's powers himself.

now.title: The Punisher S2
now.text: In episode 2, Beth spends a night with Frank, is shot in the bar fight, and is threatened by Pilgrim in the hospital.
cases: ST-075 The Siege of the Larkville Sheriff Station (The Punisher S2)

changes.evidence: The record covers Beth's night with Frank and the bar shooting in Michigan (S2E1) and Pilgrim threatening her in the Michigan hospital (S2E2). The Larkville sheriff station siege happens in Larkville, Ohio, involving Frank, Amy and Marlena; Beth is not part of it.
